description: Backups of data are not created, protected, maintained, and tested.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for missing backup schedules, unencrypted backups, lack of backup testing procedures, inadequate backup retention policies, failure to verify backup integrity, and absence of secure backup storage locations.
